provisioning.note: The Drive node and all four Bases below are an existing production Busabase workspace, not a Folder+Bases tree this AirApp creates or owns. An operator provisions/repairs them with the trusted scripts in the skill-root scripts/ directory (export_busabase_snapshot.mjs / restore_busabase_snapshot.mjs / backfill_pdf_metadata.mjs). The AirApp only resolves these resources by slug and reads them; a missing resource degrades to a snapshot warning instead of blocking behind a setup screen.
